summary.finding: Asian surnames with Anglo first names
summary.data: Same surname, Asian vs Anglo first name: Emily Chen and Mei Chen equally common in pretraining; Emily Chen 3.7× as common after it
summary.source: Checkpoint experiment. The post-training data also shifts Emily Chen : Mei Chen from 1:1 to 3.7:1

summary.evidence: base model 23 of 24 · Asian surnames 3% → 18% of personas after SFT

summary.finding: Every spouse opposite-sex; men get the family

summary.why: Both skews start in pretraining and get 2.5–4× stronger after it.
summary.label: same-sex spouses
summary.evidence: base model: 0 of 106 spouses same-sex · data 1% → 0.2%
